about: src/lib/pos_metrics_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (the backend and the till average a ticket with madar-money::metrics::average_ticket; lib/average-ticket.test.ts runs the dashboard's average against its windows). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
